objectives: This service-learning course invites students to connect classroom learning with community engagement through participation, collaboration, and reflection. Selected service-learning activities will be arranged throughout the semester, including campus-based and community-oriented forms of service. Students will learn to understand service as a process of mutual learning and social responsibility, while developing basic capacities for communication, teamwork, ethical awareness, and civic engagement.
